zh: 3 组 × 30 秒，不许塌腰后坐。

en: 3×8 squats; Bulgarian split squat 3×6 each side.
zh: 双腿深蹲 3×8；保加利亚分腿蹲每侧 3×6。

en: A light pole touch at each edge change, hands kept in front.
zh: 每次换刃轻点一次雪杖，双手保持在身前。

en: A metric that could not be measured says so — it is never shown as a zero.
zh: 无法测得的指标会如实标注，绝不以 0 分呈现。

en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.
zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。

en: About hip-width; wider usually means you're still in a wedge.
zh: 站距约髋宽；过宽说明犁式没收干净。

en: Analyze the clip first to open the report.
zh: 请先完成分析后再查看报告。

en: Avoid sharp bumps, jumps, and a too-narrow line.
zh: 避开尖包、跳台和过窄的线。

en: Balance on the outside ski before carving.
zh: 刻滑前先能把重量放在外侧板上。

en: Bounce both skis together in soft snow to feel the snow push back.
zh: 在松软雪中两只板一起上下起伏，感受雪面的回弹。

en: Camera motion could not be judged from this clip.
zh: 本段无法判断镜头运动。

en: Carve points are heuristics, not FIS carving scores.
zh: 刻滑要点为经验估分，不是 FIS 刻滑得分。

en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.
zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。

en: Check the rental skis still have edges before the first run.
zh: 上道前先检查租用雪板的钢边是否还在。

en: Clear up-and-down movement in every turn; a static stance sinks the tips.
zh: 每个转弯都有明显的上下起伏；站姿僵直会让板头下沉。

en: Click the filmstrip to seek; green diamonds are saved boxes (click to jump). Drag the blue start/end edges to trim. Shift+wheel zooms. Draw a person box — it saves for this frame; draw again on the same frame to replace.
zh: 点击胶片跳转；绿色菱形是已记录的框（点击可跳到该帧）。拖蓝色开始/结束边裁剪。Shift+滚轮缩放。在人物上拖框，松手记录到当前帧；同一帧再框选会覆盖该帧。

en: Coach heuristics, not FIS judging or medical advice. 2D pose can misread. Pain or prior injury: see a coach or clinician.
zh: 滑雪教练经验估分，非 FIS 裁判分，非医疗建议。2D 骨骼会误判。疼痛或旧伤请线下教练/医师。

en: Control speed with turn shape, not by scraping the tails across the fall line.
zh: 用转弯弧形控速，而不是把板尾横过落差线搓雪。

en: Cross from edge to edge quickly; a ski left flat slides away on hardpack.
zh: 两侧立刃之间快速过渡；在硬雪上雪板一放平就会滑走。

en: Deepest flexion in the middle of the arc, not at the finish — no park-and-ride.
zh: 最深的蹲屈出现在弧线中段，而不是收弯处——不要立刃后干等。

en: Delete this clip and its local files? This cannot be undone.
zh: 删除该条目及本地文件？此操作不可恢复。

en: Display only: 2D pose does not score air or ski tips. Train with a coach.
zh: 仅目录展示：2D 骨骼不评空中与板尖。请线下教练。

en: Display only: boxes, rails, and jumps are not scored.
zh: 仅目录展示：箱、杆、跳台不自动打分。

en: Display only: boxes, rails, and jumps with a coach; the app does not score them.
zh: 仅目录展示：箱、杆、跳台需教练指导；本 App 不评分。

en: Display only: this app does not time gates.
zh: 仅目录展示：本 App 不做旗门计时。

en: Display only: v2 video does not classify switch.
zh: 仅目录展示：v2 视频不自动判定倒滑。

en: Distances are normalized to this skier's leg length.
zh: 距离按本人腿长归一化。

en: Do not spin the shoulders with the skis.
Don't land or absorb with locked, straight legs.
zh: 不要用锁死的直腿落地或缓冲。

en: Draw a person box before confirming.
zh: 请拖出一个人物框后再确定。
动态平行式：节奏与用杖

en: Easy slope, parallel or wedge: tap the downhill pole each turn.
zh: 缓坡平行或犁式，每弯轻点山下杖。

en: Eight each side; if speed builds, reset to a traverse before stopping.
zh: 每侧 8 次；速度一起来先回到斜滑再刹。

en: Eight medium turns on the same pitch; cadence between long and short.
zh: 同一坡面 8 个中弯，频率高于大弯、低于小弯。

en: Eight straight lines over round, shallow bumps.
zh: 选圆而浅的包沿沟直滑 8 次。

en: Eight turns on green or blue; match the inside ski only in the last third of the turn.
zh: 绿/蓝道做 8 个弯，只在出弯后三分之一并内侧板。

en: Elastic knees and ankles; not locked.
Enter name, height, weight, and ski length, or pick a saved profile.
zh: 请填写姓名、身高、体重和雪板长度，或选择已存档案。

en: Equipment guidance is a starting range from height and weight, not a boot fitting.
zh: 装备建议是依据身高体重给出的起始范围，不能替代专业量脚定制。

en: Extend into the new turn and flex through the arc; count the rhythm out loud.
zh: 换刃时伸展，走弧线时蹲屈；出声数节奏。

en: Fast edge change, quieter shoulders. End of the groomed carve branch.
zh: 快换刃，肩更静。平整道刻滑枝终点。

en: Faster edge changes without losing parallel inclination.
zh: 快换刃但平行与内倾不能丢。

en: Few high-quality sets; do not train fatigue into poor form.
zh: 组数少、质量高，避免以疲劳换变形。

en: Fewer traverses, linked absorption; still no air scoring.
zh: 少横切，连续吸收，仍不开空中评分。

en: Filmed almost face-on: fore/aft balance cannot be measured. Film from a quarter angle, behind and to one side.
zh: 画面几乎正对：前后平衡无法测量。请从斜后方约 45° 拍摄。

en: Filmed almost side-on: stance, edging and lean cannot be measured. Film from a quarter angle, behind and to one side.
zh: 画面几乎正侧：站距、立刃和内倾都无法测量。请从斜后方约 45° 拍摄。

en: Filmed too face-on to measure this.
zh: 拍摄角度过于正面，该项无法测量。

en: Filmed too side-on to measure this.
zh: 拍摄角度过于正侧，该项无法测量。

en: Filming checklist for the next clip
Flatten both skis to slip sideways, then edge again to stop — neither a locked edge nor a free slide.
zh: 把两只板放平向侧下方滑，再立刃停住——既不是锁死立刃，也不是失控下滑。

en: Flex and extend to surface the skis
Follow-cam; one alpine skier in frame.
zh: 跟拍手机，画面尽量只框一名双板滑者。

en: Four posture scores are coach heuristics (0–100), not lab biomechanics; they are not true speed, meter turn radius, or peak ski pressure.
zh: 姿态四维为教练经验估分评分（0–100），非实验室生物力学测量；不含真实滑行速度、转弯半径米制或板底峰值压力。

en: From a gentle traverse, pivot both skis across the hill and set the edges to a stop.
zh: 从缓坡斜滑降开始，双板同时横切并立刃停下。

en: From a traverse, pressure the outside ski through a small C, then switch sides.
zh: 斜滑降开始，外侧加压划小 C，再换另一侧。

en: From the skid branch: absorb and stay on snow; do not jump.
zh: 从搓雪枝进入：先吸收贴雪，不要跳。

en: Gate metrics decide advancement; the rest are diagnostic.
zh: 关键项决定能否升级，其余为参考项。

en: Glide straight in a wedge and stop on purpose.
zh: 用犁式板形直线下山并主动停下。

en: Grant camera access to run pose tracking.
zh: 请允许相机权限以进行姿态跟踪。

en: Heuristic inclination and parallel stance, not FIS. Learn one-ski first.
zh: 经验估分内倾与平行，非 FIS。最好先掌握单脚滑。

en: Heuristic: steer with the legs — rotate the femurs so the ski tips turn while the torso stays quiet.
zh: 经验提示：用腿转向——髋内旋带动板头转向，上身保持安静。

en: Hips or ankles are missing in much of the clip.
zh: 本段大部分画面缺少髋或踝关键点。

en: Hips over the feet; pressure into the ski.
zh: 髋在脚上方，压力送到板刃。

en: Hold a clean edge on hardpack: edge early, change edges quickly, no braking scrape.
zh: 在硬雪或冰面上保持干净的立刃：提早立刃、换刃迅速、不靠搓雪刹车。
若未进阶，按下述目标训练
入点 {lo:.1f}s → 出点 {hi:.1f}s（逻辑裁剪，不改原文件）

en: Indoors or flat ground for stance and single-leg strength.
zh: 室内或平地，练站姿和单腿力量。

en: Keep pole tips low and hands in front of the body, about waist to mid-torso, to time left–right turns.
zh: 杖尖放低，手在身前约腰至胸中，给左右转弯节拍。

en: Keep the arc round with both skis working; do not throw the skis sideways.
zh: 保持弧形圆顺、两只板一起工作；不要把雪板横甩出去。

en: Keep the camera steady — shaky or wild motion prevents a reliable stage assessment.
zh: 保持镜头稳定——剧烈晃动会导致阶段无法可靠判定。

en: Knee flex cadence matches the bumps.
zh: 膝屈伸节奏与雪包合拍。

en: Knees track over the toes; don't let the knees collapse inward.
zh: 膝沿脚尖方向；不要让膝盖向内塌。

en: Large knee travel; stay on snow rather than jumping.
zh: 膝屈振幅大，贴雪而不是跳。

en: Left-right turns, not a straight schuss.
zh: 有左右转向，不是一条直线冲坡。

en: Legs and hips steer; do not use the shoulders as a steering wheel.
zh: 用腿和髋改变板向，肩不要当方向盘。

en: Legs move; the torso stays quieter.
Let the legs do the work.
Optional: use Label skis on key frames before Start analysis.
zh: 可选：在「开始分析」前，用「标注雪板」在关键帧上标左右板头板尾。

en: Link bumps near the fall line with less traversing.
zh: 少横切，沿落差线连贯过包。

en: Linked absorption near the fall line. No air score.
zh: 少横切的连续吸收。不评空中。

en: Linked parallel turns with an even rhythm, a flex-and-extend move, and a pole touch at every edge change.
zh: 连贯的平行式转弯：节奏均匀、蹲伸配合，每次换刃点一次雪杖。

en: Linked short skids on parallel skis; mixed edge and skid is acceptable.
zh: 平行板快速左右转换控速，允许刃搓混合。
吻合度 {fit:.0f}% · 关键项 {gate:.0f}% · 先验 {prior:.0f}%

en: Matched skis and separation. After passing, choose short skids or long-radius carve.
zh: 双板平行，上下分离。过关后可选搓雪或刻滑大弯。

en: Mean stance between a full wedge and parallel.
zh: 平均站距介于大犁与平行之间。
缺少模型 {path}。请先运行：python scripts/download_pose_landmarker.py

en: Moderate groomed blue run; for parallel, skids, and long-radius carve.
zh: 中等平整蓝道；适合平行、搓雪与大弯刻滑。

en: Most turns finish with a shaped arc; a slip to recover is fine, a slipped descent is not.
zh: 多数转弯要走出弧形；偶尔侧滑找回节奏可以，一路横滑下坡不行。

en: Needs a scene fact before it can be detected.
zh: 需要补充场地信息才能自动识别。

en: Never ski off-piste alone; avoid avalanche terrain and sidecountry, and keep a partner in sight.
zh: 不要独自滑野雪；避开雪崩地形与界外区域，始终与同伴保持在视线内。

en: No camera found. On the emulator, use a virtual scene or webcam.
zh: 未找到相机。模拟器请启用虚拟场景或电脑摄像头。

en: No linked turns were detected in this clip.
zh: 本段没有检测到连续转弯。

en: No linked turns were detected, so turn-by-turn checkpoints are not scored. Film several linked turns.
zh: 未检测到连续转弯，逐弯要点不评分。请拍几个连续转弯。

en: No stage report yet. Analyze a clip offline first.
zh: 暂无阶段报告。请先离线分析视频。

en: No terrain suggestion at this stage; use the runs you already ski well.
zh: 本阶段不指定地形；在你已经滑得好的雪道上练。

en: No turns were segmented in this clip.
zh: 这段视频没有切分出完整的转弯。

en: Non-slip floor; a handhold nearby helps.
zh: 防滑地面，旁边有扶手更好。

en: Not passed — train the lowest-scoring checkpoint.
zh: 尚未过关：按得分最低的要点训练。

en: Nothing could be measured for this stage in this clip; re-film before training to a number.
zh: 本段测不出该阶段的任何指标；请先重拍，再按数据训练。

en: On a green run, stand across the hill, flatten both skis to slip, then edge to stop; ten repeats each way.
zh: 在初级道上横向站好，放平两只板开始侧滑，再立刃停住；每侧十次。

en: On a short steep section, pivot-slip eight times; link short turns only once the upper body stays quiet.
zh: 在一小段陡坡上做八次转板侧滑；只有上身保持安静后再连成小回转。

en: On land: athletic stance, rotate the femurs to turn the toes, keep the shoulders still.
zh: 陆上模拟：微屈站，左右髋内旋带动脚尖，肩不动。

en: One cell per turn along the clip. Flagged turns are highlighted; click a turn to jump to it.
zh: 按时间顺序每个方块代表一个弯，标记出的是有问题的弯；点击方块可跳转到该弯。

en: Only try boxes, rails, or jumps with a coach, a helmet, and a supervised park.
zh: 只在有教练、戴头盔且受监管的公园尝试箱、杆或跳台。

en: Only {count} turns were detected; film at least 8 linked turns for a rhythm score.
zh: 只检测到 {count} 个转弯；要评节奏请拍至少 8 个连续转弯。

en: Open the report on the player page to jump to this frame.
zh: 请在播放页打开报告以跳到该帧。

en: Open the tails and edge to a stop; do not sit down.
zh: 推开板尾并立刃急停；不要一屁股坐下。

en: Ordered for your weakest metric first: {metric}
zh: 已按你最弱的指标优先排序：{metric}

en: Out point must be after in point.
Parallel-ski emergency stop; required braking skill before short skidded turns.
zh: 平行板急停；进入搓雪小弯前的必过刹车技能。

en: Passed this level. Choose a next level on the skill tree.
zh: 已过关，可选下一阶段（技能树分叉）。

en: Pick a branch, film your own skiing, and run your own practice cycle.
zh: 选定一个方向，拍摄自己的滑行，建立自己的训练循环。

en: Pick the gentlest pitch; avoid ice and crowded runouts.
zh: 选最缓的坡，避开冰面和拥挤出口。

en: Pivot both skis under a quiet upper body, slip a short distance, then pivot back.
zh: 在安静的上身下方把两只板转过来，短距离侧滑后再转回去。

en: Possible stage — confidence is below the gate, so both candidates are shown.
zh: 可能级别——置信度低于门槛，因此同时列出两个候选级别。

en: Practice inclination on blue before moving to red; drop to an easier pitch when form fades.
zh: 先在蓝道练内倾再上红道；动作变形时降到更缓的坡。

en: Prefer fewer people and softer snow; shallower turns on ice.
zh: 人少、雪软一点更好；冰面减小弯深。

en: Pressure peaks in the shaping phase
zh: 压力峰值出现在转弯中段

en: Progression rung — not judged from a clip.
zh: 进阶阶梯中的一环，视频无法判定。

en: Put the gear on, walk on the flat, glide a few metres, and get up after a fall.
zh: 穿好装备，在平地上行走，滑出几米，摔倒后能自己站起来。

en: Quick edge change on firm snow

zh: 快速左右转换，不要长横切。

en: Quiet, easy green run — master the wedge stop first.
zh: 安静缓坡绿道——先掌握犁式制动。

en: Re-film this stage so its checkpoints can be measured.
zh: 请重拍本阶段，以便测量各项要点。

en: Reach the standard on {name} to advance.
Reach the standard on {name}, then move to {next}.
Read the terrain and pick a line in crud, cut-up snow and gladed trees. Inside the resort boundary only.
zh: 在烂雪、被翻过的雪面和林间稀疏树区里读地形、选线路。仅限雪场界内。

en: Record at least one person box.
zh: 请至少记录一帧人物框。

en: Release both edges to slip sideways, then re-set them to stop; the torso keeps facing downhill.
zh: 同时放平两只板的立刃，向侧下方侧滑，再立刃停住；上身始终朝向山下。

en: Round bumps, an open line, visible troughs; do not force a black run.
zh: 包圆、线空、能看到沟；不要为了黑道硬上。

en: Round, progressive long turns with parallel skis and inclination — coach heuristic, not a race carve score.
zh: 平行板内倾做圆顺大弯——教练经验估分，非竞速刻滑得分。

en: Round, shallow bumps; absorb in a straight line first.
zh: 圆而浅的包，先直滑吸收。

en: Set the edge above the fall line so the ski grips before it points down the hill.
zh: 在过落差线之前就立好刃，让雪板先咬住雪面再指向坡下。

en: Sets of 8–12 bumps; stop when form fades.
zh: 八到十二个包一组，累了就停。

en: Sex is used only for fit guidance and the injury note; it never changes a score.
zh: 性别只用于装备贴合建议和受伤提示，绝不影响评分。

en: Shallow C-turns while the wedge still brakes; load the outside ski.
zh: 在仍能刹车的前提下划浅 C，外侧板承重。

en: Shallow C-turns; hip internal rotation steers; the wedge stays.
zh: 浅弧 C 弯，髋内旋导向，弯中保持犁。

en: Short turns on a steep pitch: the upper body faces down the fall line and turn shape controls the speed.
zh: 陡坡上的小回转：上身朝向落差线，用转弯弧形控速。

en: Short-radius skids for speed control; hockey stop required. Then moguls.
zh: 短半径搓雪控速；必须掌握冰球刹。过关可进雪包。

en: Shorten the legs at the crest, lengthen in the trough; stay on snow, do not jump.
zh: 包顶缩短腿、沟底伸长；腿贴雪，不要跳。

en: Shorten the radius only after long-radius inclination works.
zh: 在大弯能倾之后缩短半径。

en: Show you can stop on command with parallel skis (both directions).
zh: 展示能用平行板按指令急停（左右两侧）。

en: Side or rear-quarter, whole run, little occlusion.
zh: 从侧面或斜后方拍完整段，少遮挡、光线足够。

en: Single-leg strength for the christie close and carve outside ski.
zh: 练单腿力量，为半犁收板与刻滑外侧承重做准备。

en: Six large C-turns on a moderate pitch; longer outside leg.
zh: 中等坡画 6 个大 C，外侧腿更长。

en: Six long turns on firm blue groomers; shorten the radius only while the track stays clean.
zh: 在硬实的中级压雪道上做六个大弧转弯；只有刻痕干净时才缩小半径。

en: Six traverses per side; put the ski down if you wobble.
zh: 每侧 6 次斜滑降；失稳就放回双脚，不要硬撑。

en: Slightly lower in the turn; elastic knees.
zh: 入弯略降重心，膝有弹性。

en: Slip down and across, forward then back, with the torso facing downhill.
zh: 雪板横置向侧下方滑行，先向前再向后，上身始终朝向山下。

en: Snow and slope are optional — leave them at not sure and the report still runs.
zh: 雪面和坡度可以不填：保持“不确定”也能生成报告。

en: Soft ankles, knees, and hips; center of mass over mid-foot.
zh: 踝膝髋微屈，重心在脚心，不后坐。

en: Soft, ungroomed snow just off a marked run; stay inside the resort boundary.
zh: 紧邻雪道的未压雪松软雪面；不要越出雪场界。

en: Some checkpoints for this stage could not be measured in this clip.
zh: 本段中该阶段的部分要点无法测量。
发挥稳定度（时间 × 当前帧分数）

en: Stable follow-cam, one skier, side or rear-quarter.
zh: 画面稳、一人、侧或斜后，才能判定阶段。

en: Stage cannot be judged when the shot is unstable, occluded, or out of curriculum scope.
zh: 镜头不稳、遮挡或非本课程种类时不判定阶段。

en: Stance width varies; not a locked wedge the whole turn.
zh: 站距有开合，不是全程死犁。

en: Standard: a clean, narrow track on hardpack with no scraped-out tail.
zh: 标准：硬雪上留下细窄干净的刻痕，板尾不搓花。

en: Standard: a clear edge change, not an upright scrape.
zh: 标准：换刃点清楚，不直立横刮。

en: Standard: both skis surface together; no single-ski dive.
zh: 标准：两只板同时浮出雪面，不出现单板下沉。

en: Standard: glide on the outside ski; the inside ski taps the snow without taking weight.
zh: 标准：缓坡外侧板滑一段，内侧板轻点雪不承重。

en: Standard: hip over ankle in profile; knees unlocked.
zh: 标准：侧面看髋在踝上方，膝不锁死。

en: Standard: hips incline into the turn, shoulders quiet, stance parallel.
zh: 标准：髋向弯心倾，肩不甩；站距保持平行。

en: Standard: hips stay near the fall line; the knees still do the work.
zh: 标准：髋大致沿落差线，少横切；仍由膝屈伸做功。

en: Standard: knees track over the toes; pelvis level.
zh: 标准：膝沿脚尖，骨盆不左右倾倒。

en: Standard: left-right symmetry, even quieter shoulders.
Standard: linked S-track, no dart to the edge; the wedge stays through the turn.
zh: 标准：连续 S 迹，不冲道边；弯中犁式不消失。

en: Standard: no long traverse between turns; knees flex and extend.
zh: 标准：弯与弯之间没有长横切；膝有屈伸。

en: Standard: on replay, the wrists stay below the shoulders.
zh: 标准：回放里手腕不高于肩。

en: Standard: quiet torso, large knee travel, no straight-leg slam.
zh: 标准：上身相对静，膝屈振幅大，落地不砸直腿。

en: Standard: stance narrows in the last third of the turn, still stable.
zh: 标准：出弯后半段站距变小，但不失稳。

en: Standard: stop on a mark both ways; skis parallel, not in a wedge.
zh: 标准：左右都能停在预定点，板平行、不犁开。

en: Standard: ten stops, tips close, torso facing downhill.
zh: 标准：十次停下板头始终相对、上身对山下。

en: Standard: the same count on every turn, with the deepest flexion in the middle of the arc.
zh: 标准：每个转弯数同样的拍子，最深的蹲屈落在弧线中段。

en: Standard: the shoulders keep facing down the pitch through every pivot.
zh: 标准：每次转板时肩线始终朝向坡下。

en: Standard: the skis start to turn while the shoulders still face downhill.
zh: 标准：板开始转时肩仍大体对山下。

en: Standard: the skis stay across the hill and the torso does not turn with them.
zh: 标准：雪板始终横向对坡，上身不跟着转。

en: Stay centered so you can move onto the new outside ski.
zh: 不后坐，才能把重量交给新的外侧板。

en: Stay in a wedge through the turn; load the outside ski.
zh: 转弯中仍保持犁式，外侧承重。

en: Stay parallel or inclination becomes banking.
zh: 站距保持平行，否则倾会变成内倒。

en: Steep/hard suggestion for fall-line moguls only; still not measured.
zh: 仅在雪包落差线课使用的陡/难建议，仍非实测。

en: Steeper groomed red run; for medium and short carve heuristics.
zh: 更陡的平整红道；适合中小弯刻滑经验课。

en: Straight-run a soft slope and bounce six times, then link the bounces into turns.
zh: 在松软坡面上直滑并起伏六次，再把起伏连成转弯。

en: Suggested black run; slope is not measured.
zh: 建议黑道；坡度未经实测。

en: Suggested blue run; slope is not measured.
zh: 建议蓝道；坡度未经实测。

en: Suggested green run; slope is not measured.
zh: 建议绿道；坡度未经实测。

en: Suggested mogul field; bump shape is not measured.
zh: 雪包场地建议，非包型实测。

en: Suggested off-piste inside the resort boundary; snow depth is not measured.
zh: 建议雪场界内的野雪区域；雪深不做测量。

en: Suggested park terrain; this app does not score air.
zh: 公园建议场地，本 App 不评空中。

en: Suggested red run; slope is not measured.
zh: 建议红道；坡度未经实测。
技术专家：骨骼判定（知识库）

en: Ten linked parallel turns on a blue run, counting one-two through every turn.
zh: 在中级道上做十个连贯的平行式转弯，每个转弯数“一—二”。

en: Ten short turns on a blue run; quiet shoulders, hands low.
zh: 蓝道平整处 10 个短弯一组，肩静手低。

en: Terrain, slope and snow are optional — set Terrain to Mogul run for mogul detection.
zh: 地形、坡度与雪况为可选项——需检测雪包滑行时请将地形设为「雪包道」。

en: The camera follows the skier, so turn rhythm is measured from the body rather than the track.
zh: 镜头跟着滑者移动，转弯节奏只能从身体判断，不能从轨迹判断。

en: The camera pans during the clip; a fixed camera measures rhythm more reliably.
zh: 拍摄过程中镜头有摇动；固定机位测节奏更可靠。

en: The clip is too short to judge rhythm. Film a whole run of at least eight turns.
zh: 本段太短，无法判断节奏。请拍完整一趟、至少八个转弯。

en: The shoulders keep facing down the pitch while the legs turn underneath.
zh: 双腿在身体下方转弯，肩线始终朝向坡下。

en: The shoulders stay square to the fall line while the skis slip.
zh: 雪板侧滑时，肩线始终正对落差线。

en: The skeleton is weak in this clip: get closer, keep the skier unoccluded, and avoid flat light.
zh: 本段骨骼质量差：请靠近一些拍，避免遮挡和平光。

en: The skeleton was too small or incomplete to measure.
zh: 骨骼太小或不完整，无法测量。

en: The {joints} could not be tracked in this clip.
zh: 本段视频中无法追踪到{joints}。

en: This clip is still processing. Play it when it is done.
zh: 该条目仍在处理中，完成后才可播放。

en: Tip the body into the turn (hips inside the arc). Heuristic only — not a measured edge angle or FIS score.
zh: 向弯心倾斜身体（髋在弧内）。仅为经验估分——非实测刃角或 FIS 得分。

en: Tips close, tails open, stance wider than the hips.
zh: 板头近、板尾开，站距宽于髋。
剪切视频（最长 2 分钟）

en: Turn durations stay close to each other; no long traverse between turns.
zh: 每个转弯的用时接近一致；转弯之间不夹长横切。

en: Turn instead of side-slipping the pitch
zh: 用转弯而不是横滑下坡

en: Two-footed, rounder turns in soft snow; flex and extend to make the skis surface.
zh: 在松软雪中双脚均匀受力、转弯更圆；靠蹲伸让雪板浮起来。

en: Unscored when the head is not visible in 2D pose.
zh: 2D 头关键点不可靠则不计分。

en: Unstable camera, occlusion, or out-of-scope terrain: no stage claim.
zh: 镜头不稳、遮挡或非本课程种类时不判定阶段。

en: Upper body down the fall line
Wedge to start, close the inside ski to finish.
Wedge to start, gradually match at the finish; do not snap shut.
zh: 入弯犁、出弯逐渐并板，禁止突然并死。

en: Wedge-glide on a green run, then open the tails and edge to a stop.
zh: 绿道犁式直滑，匀速后再推开板尾立刃停下。

en: What the clip itself could tell us
zh: 这段视频本身能告诉我们什么

en: Your skis at {own} cm sit inside that band.
zh: 你现用的 {own} 厘米雪板在该范围内。

en: Your skis at {own} cm sit outside that band.
zh: 你现用的 {own} 厘米雪板不在该范围内。
{total} 次换刃中有 {n} 次出现{fault}

en: {n} more rows in the full module
zh: 完整模块中还有 {n} 行
{total} 个弯中有 {n} 个出现该问题
根据{current}表现预判为已通过

en: e.g. This is a mogul skiing clip, not a basic glide
zh: 例如：这是蘑菇滑雪视频，不是基本滑行

en: Your correction is saved locally and helps improve the detection algorithm.
zh: 您的纠正已保存到本地，将用于改善检测算法。

en: Navigate mogul terrain with wedge or semi-parallel; absorb bumps and stay rhythmic. Early entry into mogul skiing after wedge turns.
zh: 以犁式或半犁在雪包地形中保持节奏，吸收冲击。从犁式转弯直接进入雪包训练的早期入口。

en: From wedge mogul or skid branch: absorb actively, stay on snow, do not jump.
zh: 从犁式雪包或搓雪枝进入：主动吸收贴雪，保持节奏，不要跳。
